slides.title: When the vendor is already on the roof and you just noticed their insurance certificate expired:

slides.label: Say this:
slides.title: "Before you start, I need your current certificate. Can your agent email it this morning?"

slides.label: If they say "oh, it renewed":
slides.title: "Great, then it'll only take your agent five minutes."
slides.body: Renewed usually means there's a new certificate. Ask for it.

slides.label: Then do this:
slides.title: Write the new expiration date down. Somewhere you'll see it before it passes.
slides.body: Not on the PDF in a folder called "Vendors 2024".

slides.label: While you're at it:
slides.title: Check the plumber, the landscaper and the snow removal crew too.
slides.body: Winter vendors start soon. Their certificates have dates as well.

slides.label: Save this
slides.title: For the next time someone shows up with a ladder and a 2024 certificate.
slides.body: Send it to whoever books your vendors.
